title: EraseAnything++: Enabling Concept Erasure in Rectified Flow Transformers Leveraging Multi-Object Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2603.00978v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Removing undesired concepts from large-scale text-to-image (T2I) and text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models while preserving overall generative quality remains a major challenge, particularly as modern models such as Stable Diffusion v3, Flux, and OpenSora employ flow-matching and transformer-based architectures and extend to long-horizon video generation. Existing concept erasure methods, designed for earlier T2I/T2V models, often fail to generalize to these paradigms. To address this issue, we propose EraseAnything++, a unified framework for concept erasure in both image and video diffusion models with flow-matching objectives. Central to our approach is formulating concept erasure as a constrained multi-objective optimization problem that explicitly balances concept removal with preservation of generative utility. translated_title: EraseAnything++：利用多目标优化在整流流Transformer中实现概念擦除
translated_abstract: 在保持整体生成质量的同时，从大规模文生图（T2I）和文生视频（T2V）扩散模型中移除不需要的概念仍然是一个重大挑战，尤其是随着Stable Diffusion v3、Flux和OpenSora等现代模型采用流匹配和基于Transformer的架构，并扩展到长时程视频生成。为早期T2I/T2V模型设计的现有概念擦除方法往往难以泛化到这些新范式。为解决这一问题，我们提出了EraseAnything++，一个针对采用流匹配目标的图像和视频扩散模型的统一概念擦除框架。我们方法的核心是将概念擦除表述为一个受约束的多目标优化问题，显式地平衡概念移除与生成能力的保持。为解决由此产生的目标冲突，我们引入了一种高效的保持生成能力的遗忘策略……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出EraseAnything++统一框架，将概念擦除建模为受约束的多目标优化问题，使流匹配架构的图像和视频扩散模型（如Stable Diffusion v3、Flux、OpenSora）能够在擦除不良概念的同时保持生成质量。
en_tdlr: EraseAnything++ is a unified framework that enables concept erasure in flow-matching based image and video diffusion models (e.g., Stable Diffusion v3, Flux, OpenSora) by formulating it as a constrained multi-objective optimization problem that balances concept removal with preserving generative quality.
